sources.snippet: The training objective of LLaDA is an upper bound on the negative log-likelihood of the model distribution, making LLaDA a generative model. This enables LLaDA to naturally perform in-context learning, instruction-following, and ensures Fisher consistency for scalability with large datasets and models.
